concept: Branding for a made-up bakery (Brindlow), rendered in 3D (Blender) on a pink paper sweep and shot from the same side three ways, the packaging changing. From high on the right: three white card boxes in a stack, each with a different logo (a blue script in an oval, green capitals between wheat ears, black lowercase beside a yellow dot). From table height: a paper bag in front with a fourth, a brown rubber stamp. Then from above: the same boxes and bag in one brand, an oxblood serif wordmark and a B monogram on cream. Pink, card white and one oxblood.
